input_text: Demand the published homogeneous bounce of a rotating 10-solar-mass parent. If all parent angular momentum reached the bounce, rotation would overshoot the causal limit by a factor of 6.6 times 10 to the power 26. Self-consistency leaves at most about 1 part in 10 to the power 27, with the treatment branches spanning roughly 1 order of magnitude. Under Reading 2, rotating collapse never reaches this homogeneous solution at all; what happens instead remains underived.
